headline: 2-year-old child sexually abused in Dhaka's South Khan
summary: The child has been admitted to Dhaka Medical College Hospital for treatment and medical examination.
details: A two-year-old child has been allegedly sexually abused in the South Khan area of the capital city, Dhaka.
Following the incident, the child was rushed to Dhaka Medical College Hospital (DMCH) for urgent medical care and examination.
The child is currently receiving treatment at the hospital as authorities investigate the incident.
This incident has sparked concern over the safety of young children in residential areas of the capital.

headline: Tragedy: Three family members killed while trying to save son
summary: A father and mother died after attempting to rescue their electrocuted son, resulting in the loss of three lives in a single incident.
details: A devastating incident occurred where a son was electrocuted, leading to a tragic chain of reaction.
In a desperate attempt to save their child, both the father and mother stepped in to help.
Unfortunately, the parents also became electrocuted in the process, leading to the death of all three family members.
The incident highlights the extreme danger of electrical accidents and the critical need for safety precautions.
